stage: opaque acquisition complete; scientific access locked
permitted_now: Archive and verify byte hashes and source metadata only. Development APIs reject reserve/calibration partitions.
not_permitted_now: count reserve coverage or word lengths
estimate reserve units, ranks, normalizers or rates
next_access: Requires a later fixed access/representation protocol and the complete applicable claim freeze. H3 remains unresolved; no reduced-statistic replacement is authorized.
failure_policy: Future unreadable, unsupported-size or unseen-unit reserve outcomes remain abstentions. They cannot trigger a repair fitted to those reserves. New repairs require another development cut and newly reserved material.
calibration: No previously inspected development text is relabeled as fresh calibration. Existing calibration stays outside all new mapping fits.
old_reserves: Exposed old reserves and parallel editions never become new development.
